slides.head:
Suno now makes video, on a model
from a firm Hollywood is suing.
Suno launches Visuals.
slides.body: On November 17 Suno added Visuals on the web. It generates video clips of up to 15 seconds, lyric videos and album art for songs made on Suno.

slides.head: Built on MiniMax H3.
slides.body: Suno's FAQ says Visuals runs on H3 Move, which is based on the H3 model from MiniMax, a Shanghai-based AI company listed in Hong Kong.

slides.head: Three studios are suing.
slides.body: Disney, Universal and Warner Bros. Discovery sued MiniMax in September 2025 over its Hailuo AI video tool. In May a judge refused to dismiss the case.

slides.head: Filters and watermarks.
slides.body: Suno says new text and visual filters block attempts to depict specific artists, public figures or copyrighted works. Outputs are watermarked before they are shared outside Suno.

slides.head: Music apps now make video.
slides.body: A 15-second clip for a song is now a built-in feature. If you make visuals for artists, direction and craft are what you sell.
